verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a native workflow-automation feature with flows and triggered events (docs-7). Its automations include lead scoring and automatic lead assignment (docs-8), which implies record updates on triggers. However, the evidence never explicitly shows workflow actions that create tasks or send notifications. Webhooks and the API are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of record-update, task-creation and notification actions in the workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation builder.
